ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white base layer containing approximately 45-55 discrete low-intensity black focal spots (geometric blobs); continuous black band along the trailing edge boundary; low-intensity vertical striations extending from the peduncle toward the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 45 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-12 pixel variations) along the continuous trailing edge; highest amplitude of jagged peaks concentrated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the upper trailing edge boundary, originating at the median notch and sweeping upward to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 50 localized circular low-intensity clusters (3-15 pixel diameters) on the white background; cluster of high-intensity white circular nodes detected on the low-intensity black region of the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (15-60 pixels in length) oriented diagonally on the medial-to-distal region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregularly serrated and jagged trailing edge topography; high-density circular pixel disruptions across the entire visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white triangular region at the point of peduncle insertion, bisected by a low-intensity vertical linear marker.
